name: Scarab Shells

faq.answer: Tran'rek is waiting in Gadgetzan for whole scarab carapaces.
faq.q: Who is asking for scarab shells?

aliases: where to turn in scarab shells
faq.answer: Tran'rek stays in the desert town of Gadgetzan.
Tran'rek needs five uncracked scarab shells brought to him in Gadgetzan.
faq.q: What kind of shells does Tran'rek need?

sections.body: Whole carapaces are hard to come by in Tanaris. Tran'rek is counting on you to bring five undamaged specimens safely back to the desert post.
sections.title: Carapaces for Gadgetzan

summary: Tran'rek is looking for uncracked scarab shells in Gadgetzan. Finding intact carapaces in the sands will spare him a great deal of trouble.
